study.question: Does explicit event-wise access to all four historical mask memberships recover the action-blind loss, and do action codes still improve click AUC when that access is identical?
study.hypothesis: The prior blind and counts-only deficits may mainly reflect loss of aligned mask-membership access through the action channel. The incumbent aggregates auxiliary masks to a union for compression, whereas action tokens enter scoring and every summary. A learned exact membership-pattern vector at those same sites may recover most of the blind deficit. If full actions remain better with the same direct membership path, they retain conditional model utility, but this alone cannot distinguish extra information from optimization effects.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary paper lines 53-88 describe ad-conditioned local-activation pooling and Dice. Preserve the local activation and actual four-task field adaptation; this proposal is a conditional representation control, not a new attention architecture or exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-170 initializes task-specific sequence hubs by task-mask pooled event embeddings. Here masks get one direct additive 16-dimensional event channel inside the unchanged incumbent. No hubs, broadcasts or new interaction stack are adopted. The benchmark implementation is not proof of equivalence to the original INFNet paper.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-175 adds item and action embeddings before transduction. This study retains the inherited concatenated action-value channel and substitutes/exposes mask information at its existing sites; no transduction/sparsity mechanism is introduced.

Inherits exactly the uniform nonpadding-codebook mean intervention. Adds a zero-initialized membership lookup before all scorer/compression/detail summaries, with a full-action arm having identical added capacity.

inherited_components: Complete g3-r0065-fixed_angle_cycle_source_bit_negative forward architecture and its nonordinary first-order context surrogate VJP, all private task graphs and joint true-label loss
Blind replacement and its original codebook-mean optimizer-exposure/scale confounds from g0-r0084-action_blind
All item/order/context, task-mask union routes, target-match exclusions and history/padding boundaries
Exact four-mask pattern coding concept from g0-r0084-action_within_membership_cycle; no donor permutation in the new forward path
study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 factorial: historical action full versus blind, crossed with explicit membership access off versus on. On-cells append nn.Embedding(16,16), zero initialized only after every original initialization in a restored CPU RNG scope; canonical bit order is is_click/cart/fav/buy resolved through feature_map.labels. Add its lookup only on valid histories to the original action-value channel before any summary. No assumed action-token-to-mask inverse is needed. On-cells have exactly the same extra 256 parameters and inherit the frozen host embedding optimizer. Off-cells reuse unmodified standalone sources. No new method or priority claim is made.
predictions: Membership-only should improve substantially over blind if access to aligned historical mask patterns explains the removal deficit; full-action membership addition should help less.

Define the conditional gap as AUC(full+membership)-AUC(blind+membership) and the interaction as [AUC(blind+membership)-AUC(blind)]-[AUC(full+membership)-AUC(full)]. The access-path hypothesis predicts a positive interaction and a much smaller conditional gap than the original full-minus-blind gap.

Use 0.0005 AUC as a predeclared practical resolution target, not a significance threshold. A conditional gap within +/-0.0005 is only a near tie in the first fixed-seed run; claim practical equivalence only if authorized paired repetitions and user-cluster intervals support it.

Blind recovery fraction is [AUC(membership_only)-AUC(blind_bridge)]/[AUC(full_bridge)-AUC(blind_bridge)] only when the bridge denominator is positive. Report this descriptive fraction with the raw deltas.
Masked/empty histories have zero new contribution, target action stays unused, and initialized on-cells reproduce their corresponding off-cells before learning.
falsifiers: A persistent material positive conditional gap with working, trained membership access undermines mask-access sufficiency for this architecture/recipe, but not information-theoretic redundancy.
No blind rescue despite finite nonzero membership gradients, adequate row exposure and learned row separation undermines this implementation of the access-path hypothesis.
Similar membership gains with and without full actions undermine a selective rescue story and leave generic capacity/optimization explanations.

If training contingency counts show multiple action codes within a membership stratum, deterministic action reconstruction from memberships is false on that observed support. Zero within-row cycle changes makes the previous cycle contrast uninformative.

Any current-label access, target action use, padding change, off-contract seed/data/scorer change, runtime-cap violation, nonfinite loss/gradients or failed initial-state parity invalidates the affected contrast.
alternative_explanations: Historical masks may be a deterministic but noninjective projection of action codes; actual support is unavailable locally.
Changing embedding row frequency/scale alters one-pass Adagrad optimization even if both representations encode the same information.
Addition of 256 parameters, redundant coding and shared channel bottleneck can influence optimization.
Action-sensitive custom context VJP can indirectly alter all task updates even when the forward intervention is confined to history values.
Single-seed variation, BF16 arithmetic, Dice state, and measured runtime noise require paired controls and repetitions.
Official offline histories may include delayed feedback not mature at prediction time; no production point-in-time utility follows.

contrasts.decision_if_supported: If the full-action arm retains a practically material advantage after direct membership access, retain a provisional claim of conditional model utility under this recipe, then require action/membership contingency diagnostics and paired repetitions before attributing the gap to extra information.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If membership_only recovers performance and the paired conditional gap is practically small, favor direct access to mask associations as an explanation of the previous deletion loss; do not claim action-event alignment or information necessity.

required_host_preflight: Before charging a training unit, check finite four-task output probabilities with shapes[B,1], finite joint loss and gradients in train and eval on real-schema synthetic inputs including all-empty, singleton and full histories. Run all checks through the authorized host; count their costs.

Compare each on-cell at zero membership initialization to its corresponding off-cell: same original parameters/buffers, predictions, original-parameter gradients, and RNG after construction within appropriate precision tolerance. The new lookup gradient is expected to be nonzero on occupied training rows.

Perturb masked historical actions/item fields/membership bits and unknown target action to verify no effect on outputs and zero masked membership contribution; compare list and tensor forms of task masks; verify all 16 valid patterns and permutations of feature_map label order.

Membership-only valid-history outputs must be invariant to arbitrary historical action-code changes when every host mask and other input is held fixed; use this as a synthetic representation test, not a sanctioned change to host history policy.
Verify both new embeddings appear in host embedding Adagrad parameter group at frozen LR; original optimizer groups and custom context VJP remain intact; no current labels reach forward.

Optional membership_diagnostics(inputs) must be explicitly invoked in the authorized host on training inputs only, aggregate action-by-membership counts and cycle changed-event/row counts. It is NOT an automatic host collector. If unavailable record not collected; do not interpret prior cycle as informative or assert deterministic reconstruction.
